verdict.rationale: Tilled's docs show the platform sets merchant pricing through pricing templates, created and managed per payment method in the Dashboard. That covers the sell-rate half of the story, though only thinly. Nothing in the pack documents a buy rate from Tilled, interchange-level cost visibility, or tooling to manage the spread. Missing for 10: documented buy rate, interchange-level cost reporting, spread/margin visibility, depth on what pricing templates can configure, independent corroboration.
